title: A record day at the New York City Marathon!
lead: On 1 November 2026, more than 60,000 runners finished the New York City Marathon. It was a new world record!
body: On Sunday 1 November 2026, a lot of people ran the New York City Marathon in the USA. A marathon is a very long race: 26.2 miles, or about 42 kilometres. The runners started on Staten Island, ran through the 5 boroughs (parts) of the city and finished in Central Park.
The winner of the men's race was Andreas Almgren from Sweden. He is 31 and it was his first marathon! He finished in 2 hours, 6 minutes and 1 second.
In the women's race, Sheila Chepkirui from Kenya won for the second time. An American runner, Jessica McClain, was second, only 6 seconds behind her.
In the wheelchair race, Marcel Hug from Switzerland won by just 1 second! And there was a world record: more than 60,000 runners finished the race. It was the biggest marathon in history!
